name: lease_abstraction
description: Abstract of a commercial office lease. One entry per document. Dates in YYYY-MM-DD. Money as plain numbers. Where the lease does not state something, the value is null; do not infer from market norms.

tenant_name.name: Tenant Name
tenant_name.original: Full legal name of the tenant (lessee) exactly as written, including the corporate suffix.
tenant_name.description: Return the tenant's (lessee's) full legal name exactly as written, including the corporate suffix.

landlord_legal_name.name: Landlord Legal Name
landlord_legal_name.original: Full legal name of the landlord (lessor) exactly as written, including the corporate suffix.
landlord_legal_name.description: Return the landlord's (lessor's) full legal name exactly as written, including the corporate suffix.

property_name.name: Property Name
property_name.original: Name of the building or property where the premises are located, if the lease gives one.
property_name.description: Return the name of the building or property where the premises are located, if the lease gives one; otherwise return null.

building_address.name: Building Address
building_address.original: Street address of the building as written in the lease, including city, state and ZIP where given.
building_address.description: Return the building's street address as written in the lease, including city, state, and ZIP code where given. Do not substitute or infer address details.

premises.name: Premises
premises.original: The suite, floor or unit identifier of the leased premises only, e.g. 'Suite 214W' or '14th Floor'. Not the street address.
premises.description: Return only the suite, floor, or unit identifier of the leased premises, such as 'Suite 214W' or '14th Floor'. Do not include the street address.

rentable_square_footage.name: Rentable Square Footage
rentable_square_footage.original: Rentable square footage of the tenant's premises as stated in the lease, as a number.
rentable_square_footage.description: Return the rentable square footage of the tenant's premises as stated in the lease, as a number.

pro_rata_share.name: Tenant's Pro Rata Share
pro_rata_share.original: Tenant's proportionate share of the building used for expense pass-throughs, as a percentage number exactly as the lease states it (0.91 for '0.91%'). null if not stated.
pro_rata_share.description: Return the tenant's proportionate share of the building used for expense pass-throughs as a percentage number in the exact numeric scale stated by the lease (for example, return 0.91 for '0.91%'). Return null if not stated.

permitted_use.name: Permitted Use
permitted_use.original: The use the tenant is permitted to make of the premises, as the lease states it. A short phrase or sentence.
permitted_use.description: Return the use the tenant is permitted to make of the premises, in a short phrase or sentence reflecting the lease's stated terms.

lease_execution_date.name: Lease Execution Date
lease_execution_date.original: The date the lease was signed or is 'made as of' / 'dated'. Not the commencement date.
lease_execution_date.description: Return the date the lease was signed or is stated to be made as of or dated, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Do not return the commencement date.

lease_commencement_date.name: Lease Commencement Date
lease_commencement_date.original: The date the lease term begins.
lease_commencement_date.description: Return the date the lease term begins, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Do not substitute the rent commencement date.

rent_commencement_date.name: Rent Commencement Date
rent_commencement_date.original: The date the tenant's rent obligation begins. May differ from the commencement date when there is free rent. If the lease does not distinguish the two, same as the commencement date.
rent_commencement_date.description: Return the date the tenant's rent obligation begins, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. It may differ from the commencement date when there is free rent; if the lease does not distinguish the two, return the commencement date.

lease_expiration_date.name: Lease Expiration Date
lease_expiration_date.original: The date the lease term ends. May be labelled termination date or expiration date.
lease_expiration_date.description: Return the date the lease term ends, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. This may be labelled the termination date or expiration date.

lease_term_months.name: Lease Term (months)
lease_term_months.original: Length of the initial term in whole months, from commencement to expiration. Compute it if the lease only gives the dates.
lease_term_months.description: Return the length of the initial term in whole months from commencement to expiration as an integer. Compute it from those dates if the lease only gives the dates.

rent_schedule_start_dates.name: Rent Schedule: Start Dates
rent_schedule_start_dates.original: List of the start date of each base rent period in the initial term, in order. One list item per period. If the rent never changes, a single item equal to the rent commencement date.
rent_schedule_start_dates.description: Return a list of start dates, formatted YYYY-MM-DD, for each base rent period in the initial term, in order. Include one item per period. If rent never changes, return a single item equal to the rent commencement date.

rent_schedule_end_dates.name: Rent Schedule: End Dates
rent_schedule_end_dates.original: List of the end date of each base rent period, aligned item by item with the start dates.
rent_schedule_end_dates.description: Return a list of the end dates of each base rent period in the initial term, formatted YYYY-MM-DD and aligned item by item with rent_schedule_start_dates.

rent_schedule_monthly_rent.name: Rent Schedule: Monthly Rent
rent_schedule_monthly_rent.original: List of the monthly base rent for each period, aligned item by item with the start dates. Numbers only.
rent_schedule_monthly_rent.description: Return a list of the monthly base rents for each period in the initial term, using numbers only and aligned item by item with rent_schedule_start_dates.

rent_schedule_annual_rent_per_rsf.name: Rent Schedule: Annual Rent per RSF
rent_schedule_annual_rent_per_rsf.original: List of the annual base rent per rentable square foot for each period, aligned with the start dates. Use the lease's figure if stated, otherwise compute monthly rent times 12 divided by rentable square footage, rounded to 2 decimals.
rent_schedule_annual_rent_per_rsf.description: Return a list of annual base rent per rentable square foot for each rent period, aligned item by item with rent_schedule_start_dates. Use the lease's stated figure if available; otherwise calculate monthly base rent × 12 ÷ rentable square footage and round to 2 decimals.

total_base_rent.name: Total Base Rent over Term
total_base_rent.original: Sum of all base rent due over the initial term, as a number. Compute from the schedule if the lease does not state it.
total_base_rent.description: Return the sum of all base rent due over the initial term as a number. Compute it from the rent schedule if the lease does not state it.

base_rent_escalation.name: Base Rent Escalation
base_rent_escalation.original: How base rent increases over the term, in a short phrase, e.g. '3% annually' or 'fixed steps per schedule' or 'none'.
base_rent_escalation.description: Describe in a short phrase how base rent increases over the term. Keep the lease's stated structure; examples include '3% annually', 'fixed steps per schedule', or 'none'. Do not infer an increase from market norms.

free_rent_months.name: Free Rent (months)
free_rent_months.original: Total months of base rent abatement granted in the initial term, as a number. 0 if none.
free_rent_months.description: Return the total number of months of base rent abatement granted in the initial term as a number. Return 0 if none.

security_deposit_amount.name: Security Deposit
security_deposit_amount.original: Cash security deposit amount as a number. If the lease shows a handwritten or amended figure, use the figure that governs.
security_deposit_amount.description: Return the cash security deposit amount as a number. If the lease shows a handwritten or amended figure, use the figure that governs.

letter_of_credit_required.name: Letter of Credit Required
letter_of_credit_required.original: true if the lease requires a letter of credit as security, false otherwise.
letter_of_credit_required.description: Return true if the lease requires a letter of credit as security; otherwise return false.

expense_structure.name: Operating Expense Structure
expense_structure.original: How operating expenses are passed to the tenant: e.g. 'base year 1993', 'expense stop $x per RSF', 'net of all expenses', 'gross'. A short phrase.
expense_structure.description: Describe in a short phrase how operating expenses are passed through to the tenant. Examples include 'base year 1993', 'expense stop $x per RSF', 'net of all expenses', or 'gross'. Use only the lease's stated terms.

base_year_expenses.name: Base Year (Expenses)
base_year_expenses.original: The base year for operating expense escalations as a four-digit year, if the lease uses a base year. null otherwise.
base_year_expenses.description: Return the four-digit base year used for operating expense escalations, if the lease uses a base year; otherwise return null. Do not infer a year.

base_year_taxes.name: Base Year (Taxes)
base_year_taxes.original: The base year for real estate tax escalations as a four-digit year, if the lease uses one. null otherwise.
base_year_taxes.description: Return the four-digit base year used for real estate tax escalations, if the lease uses one; otherwise return null. Do not infer a year.

electricity_provision.name: Electricity
electricity_provision.original: How electricity for the premises is provided and billed: included in rent, separately metered, a fixed charge per RSF, etc. A short phrase.
electricity_provision.description: Describe in a short phrase how electricity for the premises is provided and billed, such as included in rent, separately metered, or a fixed charge per RSF. Use the lease's stated provision; do not infer one.

parking_spaces.name: Parking Spaces
parking_spaces.original: Number of parking spaces granted to the tenant, as a number, only if the lease states a count. null otherwise.
parking_spaces.description: Return the stated number of parking spaces granted to the tenant as a number. Return null if the lease does not state a count; do not infer one.

parking_monthly_charge.name: Parking Monthly Charge
parking_monthly_charge.original: Monthly charge per parking space as a number, only if stated. null otherwise.
parking_monthly_charge.description: Return the stated monthly charge per parking space as a number. Return null if the lease does not state a charge; do not infer one.

ti_allowance_total.name: Tenant Improvement Allowance
ti_allowance_total.original: Total tenant improvement allowance as a number, if the lease or its work letter states one. null otherwise.
ti_allowance_total.description: Return the total tenant improvement allowance as a number if the lease or its work letter states one; otherwise return null.

renewal_option_exists.name: Renewal Option
renewal_option_exists.original: true if the tenant has an option to renew or extend, false otherwise.
renewal_option_exists.description: Return true if the tenant has an option to renew or extend; otherwise return false.

renewal_options_count.name: Number of Renewal Options
renewal_options_count.original: How many renewal options the tenant holds, as a number. 0 if none.
renewal_options_count.description: Return the number of renewal options held by the tenant. Return 0 if none.

renewal_term_months.name: Renewal Term (months)
renewal_term_months.original: List of the length of each renewal option in months. Empty list if none.
renewal_term_months.description: Return a list of the lengths, in months, of each renewal option, in order and aligned with the options. Return an empty list if there are no renewal options.

renewal_notice_months.name: Renewal Notice (months)
renewal_notice_months.original: List of the advance notice in months the tenant must give to exercise each renewal option, aligned with the terms. Empty list if none.
renewal_notice_months.description: Return a list of the advance notice periods, in months, the tenant must give to exercise each renewal option, aligned item by item with the renewal terms. Return an empty list if there are no renewal options.

early_termination_right.name: Tenant Early Termination Right
early_termination_right.original: true if the tenant may terminate before expiration under a stated option, false otherwise.
early_termination_right.description: Return true if the tenant may terminate before expiration under a stated option; otherwise return false.

termination_fee_description.name: Termination Fee
termination_fee_description.original: How any termination fee is calculated, in a short phrase. null if there is no termination right.
termination_fee_description.description: Describe in a short phrase how any termination fee is calculated. Return null if there is no termination right.

right_to_sublet.name: Right to Sublet or Assign
right_to_sublet.original: Whether and on what condition the tenant may sublet or assign, in a short phrase, e.g. 'with landlord consent, not unreasonably withheld'.
right_to_sublet.description: Describe in a short phrase whether and on what conditions the tenant may sublet or assign; for example, 'with landlord consent, not unreasonably withheld'. Use the lease's stated terms.

guarantor_name.name: Guarantor
guarantor_name.original: Full name of any guarantor of the lease. null if there is no guaranty.
guarantor_name.description: Return the full name of any guarantor of the lease. Return null if there is no guaranty.

broker_names.name: Brokers
broker_names.original: List of the real estate brokers or brokerage firms named in the lease. Empty list if none are named.
broker_names.description: Return a list of the real estate brokers or brokerage firms named in the lease. Return an empty list if none are named.

late_fee.name: Late Fee
late_fee.original: The late payment charge as the lease states it, in a short phrase, e.g. '5% of the overdue amount' or 'interest at 18% per annum'. null if not stated.
late_fee.description: Return the late payment charge in a short phrase reflecting the lease's stated terms; examples include '5% of the overdue amount' or 'interest at 18% per annum'. Return null if not stated.

holdover_rent.name: Holdover Rent
holdover_rent.original: The rent payable if the tenant holds over after expiration, as the lease states it, e.g. '150% of the last monthly rent'. null if not stated.
holdover_rent.description: Return the holdover rent payable after expiration in a short phrase, exactly reflecting the lease's stated terms; for example, '150% of the last monthly rent'. Return null if not stated.
